components.problem: Kernel ridge regression on regular H x W (and H x W x D) grids is a workhorse of spatial ML, but its two structural accelerations are blocked on real tasks: (1) the block-circulant-with-circulant-blocks (BCCB)/FFT spectral solve assumes toroidal boundary conditions, producing a large relative modeling gap (0.9496 Matern-3/2, 0.1159 RBF free-vs-torus gap; results/iter2/P0-pilot-gate-real.json) against the true free-boundary kernel; (2) under missing-data masks the Gram becomes (P_m K P_m^T + lambda I), breaking BCCB diagonalization, so the standard fallback - preconditioned conjugate gradients on a BTTB matvec - converges slowly (rate means 245-281 iterations at tol 1e-8, per-field span 233-291; RMSE means 0.53-0.54; results/iter2/T1b-CG-masked-train.json). Both bottlenecks must be resolved without O(N^2) memory or O(N^3) compute. Gaps closed: G5 bounded-residual approximate free-boundary fast grid kernel solves (residual bound measured and reported per run; mirrored in the win rule); G6 masked-input fast solves (spectral-spatial AM with circulant-accelerated Anderson mixing); G7 multi-domain regular-grid benchmark with pre-registered thresholds (>= 3x speedup over PCG at residual tol < 1e-6; >= 50% free-boundary gap reduction vs standard BCCB wrapping); G8 boundary-controlled GRF simulation tooling (controlled free/Dirichlet/Neumann/mixed boundary conditions via conditional simulation; Paciorek-Schervish non-stationary covariance).
components.method: S1 RE-ABLRC: whole-sample symmetric embedding - the (2H-1)x(2W-1) [resp. 3D analog] first-column extension, DCT-I-class (Martucci entry 45) - of the free-boundary BTTB kernel Gram, NOT half-sample reflective padding (2H per axis). Acronym mapping: the iteration-3 corpus's 'RE (Reflective Embedding)' in Gap Coverage G5 denotes this same whole-sample symmetric construction. Woodbury correction on the confined edge band of width w = ceil(2.5*rho) (rho = kernel range in grid units; single 2.5 factor): rank r_2d = O(w(H+W)); 2D cost O(N log N) solve + O(r^2 (H+W)) time, O(N + r^2) memory. 3D: correction restricted to edge-bands, r_3d = w(HW+HD+WD); runs capped at 24^3 (at w=3: r_3d = 3*1728 = 5184, r^2 ~ 26.9e6 doubles ~ 215 MB, within the 7 GB cap); 48^3 arm uses embedding-only + PCG cross-check (pre-registered cap). Masked-inversion degradation is NOT handled by S1 (mask bands have O(N) boundary); masked solves are handled by S2 alone. Residual acceptance cap: median reported solve residual bound <= 1e-6 relative, so a sloppy low-rank solve cannot pass the >= 50% gap-reduction win on truncation error alone. S2 SSAM-CAM: spectral-spatial alternating minimization for the masked system. Coefficients restricted to observed-cell support a = P_m^T w, so the objective is exactly the masked-Gram system (P_m K P_m^T + lambda I) w = y_m - the SAME system the standard PCG reference solves (results/iter2/T1b convention); the shared system is spelled inside A2. Spectral step: FISTA-momentum gradient step on r_t = P_m(K a - y) with circulant BCCB preconditioner (floored spectrum) applied to the free-boundary operator (never torus wrapping in masked arms); spatial step: soft projection on observed cells (Lagrange-multiplier proximal update; hard-clamp fixed point = the lambda->0 interpolant, explicitly avoided); Anderson mixing on the residual sequence, window m = 5 (fixed). Termination: KKT residual of the masked-Gram system, r_t := (P_m K P_m^T + lambda I) w - y_m, in relative norm ||r_t||_2/||y_m||_2 < 1e-6 (primary) / < 1e-8 (matched secondary) - IDENTICALLY defined on the same system and same relative convention as the PCG reference (PCG final relative residual 5e-9..8e-9 in results/iter2/T1b). RMSE-parity vs the PCG reference is the equivalence criterion; fixed-point equality is stated as an empirically-tested claim (corpus entry 50 caveat), not a proof. Step schedule eta_k = 0.5/(1 + k/200), iteration ceiling 500 (budget-mediated, pre-registered).
components.experiment_design: Arms (per-arm budget envelope: A1<=25, A2<=30, A3<=20, A4<=5, A5<=5, A6<=5 min; total <= 90 min; CPU-only, 12 cores, ~7 GB). A1 boundary: synthetic free-boundary GRFs (Matern-3/2, 5/2, RBF), 2D 64x64/128x128, 3D 24^3: dense free-boundary reference = Cholesky at 64x64 and 24^3 ONLY; at 128x128 the reference is a PCG solve of the free-boundary BTTB system at tol 1e-8 (dense-equivalent) - this convention is stated inside arm A1 AND in win_rules (not only the budget). Methods: standard BCCB wrapping, RE-ABLRC, DCT/DST symmetric-convolution comparator (Martucci entry 45). Win: median relative free-boundary gap reduction >= 50% (2D+3D pooled) with median reported residual bound <= 1e-6 (acceptance cap); secondary DCT/DST consequence: S1 must capture >= 50% of DCT/DST's own gap reduction, else the boundary claim is reported as NOT validated against the strongest boundary-aware classical baseline. w-sweep {1,2,3,4} fail-fast if the residual does not decay monotonically (guards the naive embed-solve plateau ~0.18 rel). A2 masked: shared system (P_m K P_m^T + lambda I) w = y_m; synthetic 2D GRF 64x64/128x128 (random 10/30/50% + block masks) and Kaplan SST v2 36x72 (polar caps, land, random masks) - REAL Kaplan fields via h5py as in iteration-2 (results/raw/real, sentinel -9.96921e36; future-blind 1856-01..2015-12 / 2016-01..2022-12); pre-stated data-route fallback: if h5py is unavailable under the allowed stack, use the simulated-from-physics stand-in with simulation_marker disclosure, never silently. Solvers: SSAM-CAM vs standard PCG at equivalent KKT residual < 1e-6 (primary) / 1e-8 (matched); win: median wall-clock speedup >= 3x pooled across synthetic + Kaplan (gate pools both; per-domain breakdown reported separately) + RMSE parity. A3 multidomain: four domains (2D GRF, 3D GRF, MNIST-784 infilling with held-out digits + patch masks, Kaplan SST v2) x five methods (dense KRR subsample <= 4000, standard PCG, KISS-GP, RFF, RE-ABLRC+SSAM-CAM) + HSS (Ambikasaran entry 54) optional sixth (attempted-if-budget; honest not-completed report if over-envelope); metrics RMSE (valid-only), wall-clock, peak RSS, accuracy-per-flop, accuracy-per-byte. A4 scaling: O(N log N)/O(N) to N~1e5 (2D 320x320, 3D 48^3 embedding-only + PCG). A5 ablation: RE-ABLRC without correction, SSAM-CAM without Anderson mixing, SSAM-CAM without circulant preconditioner, AND the joint arm S1xS2 (masked + free-boundary composition: RE-ABLRC-corrected operator inside SSAM-CAM's spectral step) + orthogonal row 'SSAM-CAM on the torus BCCB operator vs the free-boundary operator' (isolates S1's marginal contribution inside masked solves). A6: boundary-controlled GRF generator (free/Dirichlet-zero/Neumann-zero/mixed boundary-value sets; Paciorek-Schervish; seeds 0-19) published in scripts/grf_boundary.py. Benchmark win rule: proposal beaten by KISS-GP on >= 2 domains or dense KRR on >= 1 domain => honest negative reported. Kaplan/random-mask seed: 7 (as iteration-2); synthetic mask draws seeded per-domain from it and recorded.
